arrive.digOne: You have a seed from the park. Tap the hammer and dig soil to plant it.
arrive.digMany: You have {n} seeds from the park. Tap the hammer and dig soil to plant them.
arrive.plantOne: You have a seed from the park. Tap your soil to plant it.
arrive.plantMany: You have {n} seeds from the park. Tap your soil to plant one.

soil: Tap the lit grid to dig soil, then press done and tap your soil to plant.
dug: Soil dug. Press done, then tap it to plant a seed.
done: Tap your soil to plant a seed.
